blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Batangas Rep. Leandro Leviste plans to personally post bail following a court arrest warrant over allegedly violating the Public Service Act, the embattled lawmaker’s spokesman said on Thursday. Lawyer Antonio La Vina said Leviste, who is reportedly in France, intends to post bail and address the legal case involving his multi-billion solar firm “when he comes back.” READ: NBI: Leviste ‘a fugitive’ in case vs solar firm Though La Vina conceded he does not know when Leviste will return to the country. “No knowledge about his date of return, except that he will come home with his mother […]...
